description: This Java class defines ServiceEcaAction, which models an action triggered by events in the OFBiz service engine, including configuration, execution logic, and error handling.

classes.name: ServiceEcaAction
classes.description: Represents an event-driven service action with configuration options and execution logic, including error handling and context updates.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked.

methods.name: getServiceMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of service invocation ('sync' or 'async').

methods.name: isPersist
methods.description: Indicates whether the action should persist.

methods.name: getShortDisplayDescription
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the action, including service name, mode, and persistence.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action based on event, mode, and context, handling errors and updating the context/results accordingly.
